title: RepoMesh AgentTeams Task Package v2 Control Data
description: base/package.json: the platform's control data for one attempt. base/ is excluded from copaw's push-back (spike S-9) and is never modified after publish, which makes this file the one reliable carrier of what the attempt was told. Read by the helper script (init/test), by the observer (auto-approval, D-23) and by the verifier (test commands and path policy, D-14).

attempt_id.description: Equals the directory name; the helper refuses to run when they differ.

test_commands.description: Frozen test commands, run in order inside the workspace by helper `test` and re-run verbatim by the verifier.

allowed_paths.description: Globs relative to the repository root; only these may change. Empty means unrestricted.

denied_paths.description: Globs relative to the repository root that must not change; wins over allowed_paths.

workspace_root.description: Absolute directory inside the worker container under which the helper creates <workspace_root>/<attempt_id>. REPOMESH_WORK_ROOT overrides it.

helper.description: Task-relative path of the helper script.

helper_commands.description: The four complete command lines, verbatim and in order: init, test, bundle, clean. The observer's auto-approval (D-23) answers a copaw Tool Guard request only when the intercepted command line equals one of these character for character; any other command is left for a human. None of them may contain a token the Tool Guard reads as dangerous (D-21).
